main_text.p: prope Sylvamducis[?] initus, in-ter Generosissimum Domi-num de Breauté, & Leckerbeetjen, vix ausim affirmare. Poterunt quibus vacat, hâc de re consulere judicium Metera-ni in suâ historiâ.Meteran. libr. 22. p. mihi 444.

Tendunt itaque nonnun-quam duella ad exercitus utilitatem quia victoria facilius obtinetur, alacritas crescit & augetur, dum paucorum fortitudo, spem facit victorie. Quod enim in singulis obtinuit, idem in universis speratur, servatâ quâ proportione. Ita soliti milites Christiani, in limitaneis Hungariæ locis, cum Turcarum militibus concurrere, facta duelli indictione, & genere armorum.
Xenoph. libr. Ex. ped. Cyri, p. mihi 100.Quinimo nonnunquam dux exercitus ab hostead[?] certamen provocatus, se sistere poterit, & ut publico honori consulat, & ut parcat sanguini suorum.

page.notes: Right margin: "Meteran. libr. 22. p. mihi 444." (the 444 is set on its own line below the note) and "Xenoph. libr. Ex. ped. Cyri, p. mihi 100." No reference marks in the text. "Sylvamducis" and "hostead" are doubtful readings of run-together or unclear letters. Long s throughout is printed as a form resembling f and is transcribed as s. "Generosissimum" and "sistere" are read from long-s forms. The running head is in the top centre, the page number at the top right.
